concept: Taking ownership of your life circumstances as they are now, regardless of how you got here
source_inspiration: original content, informed by founder-mindset ownership tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic adult scenario shaped by past decisions (their own or others') that they now have to work within, whether or not they'd choose that starting point
exercise.reflection_prompt: What's actually within your power to change from here, regardless of how you got here?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one concrete action within their real, current power

assessment.success_marker: adult names a genuine present-tense action, not a wish that the past had gone differently
